title: Avoid simple projected group aggregate name display allocation
description: Replace simple_projected_group_aggregate_projection dispatch via func.name.to_string().to_uppercase() with direct ObjectNamePart matching.

criteria: Simple projected group aggregate planning no longer builds uppercase display names before classifying supported functions
COUNT star, SUM column, and ARRAY_AGG column behavior remains unchanged
Qualified names remain rejected by the simple aggregate check

notes: The planner now maps supported function names to static accumulator names through direct ObjectNamePart comparisons.
The accumulator name String is allocated only after the function is recognized as supported.
The later simple join and fallback aggregate planner paths still have their own uppercase allocations and remain next-task candidates.
